prompt:
Create ICON-UI-01 / Settlement Icons and HUD as the next STATIC asset board in Civilization Town / Living Settlement. Use the exact same original world imagery and building/citizen designs from WORLD-01, CHAR-01 and BLDG-01.

PLATFORM: Desktop game-art review, not an analytics application.

REQUIRED PAGE CONTENT:
1. Main icon master image: exactly nineteen individually illustrated pixel-art pictograms, arranged in a 4-row x 5-column matrix with one empty final slot. Leave generous background between icons and place labels in the surrounding review HTML, not in icon pixels. Reading order:
 Row 1: wood (small bundled logs), stone (three raw rocks), food (basket of harvested vegetables/grain), coins (stacked coins), population (two small people).
 Row 2: happiness (expressive smiling face), construction (hammer and timber joint), technology (research scroll and gear), town_center (the specific BLDG-01 hall), primitive_house (the specific BLDG-01 cottage).
 Row 3: farm (fenced planted field), lumber_camp (lean-to with stacked logs), stone_quarry (rock-face excavation), storage_hut (storehouse and crate), research_hut (study cottage with book).
 Row 4: dirt_road (path junction), agriculture (sprouting seed and grain), masonry (fitted stone blocks and chisel), toolmaking (anvil and hand tool), blank.
 These must be ORIGINAL drawn image pictograms. Do not use Unicode, emoji, Material Symbols, Font Awesome, stock SVGs, or the same symbol for different IDs. Food/farm/agriculture must look different; stone/stone_quarry/masonry must look different.
2. Separate large static game HUD composition using the world illustration as its actual playfield. Keep at least 70% of the village unobscured. Include compact upper resource strip showing only wood, stone, food, coins; population and happiness nearby. Small construction dock at the lower edge, tabs Housing / Production / Infrastructure / Community, cards for existing ancient buildings. A compact selected-building inspector shows name, static cost/work/worker example data, Assign/Unassign controls; use no charts, quests or new economy systems. Zoom plus/minus and cancel/demolish/clear controls remain readable.
3. UI art components section: resource strip, construction card, category tab, inspector panel, tool button, zoom button, valid placement indicator, invalid placement indicator and selected-building footprint. Show neutral, selected and disabled appearances as static side-by-side states, not animations.
4. Clearly label original icon sources, 24x24 intended icon target and export status. Follow the project design system for styling; do not invent a second interface brand.

CONSTRAINTS:
- Actual downloadable original artwork for the icon sheet; UI can be HTML with reusable visual components.
- No motion: no animated HUD, CSS transitions, GIF, flashing indicators or camera demo.
- No unsupported claim of alpha-ready assets. A uniform background is acceptable for image masters.
- Do not replace the art with a generic dashboard or large sidebar. The world remains the focus.

screens.title:
Authentic 16-bit retro isometric strategy game pixel-art UI icon sprite master sheet: "ICON-01 Settlement Icons (4x5 Matrix)" on a solid, completely flat, uniform parchment beige background (#E7DABC) with generous empty space separating every single icon for clean sprite isolation and extraction. Crisp pixel clusters, dark plum contour outline (#302C36), upper-right sunlight direction, restrained 2-3 shade steps from the Living Settlement 28-color palette (#59845A, #527B8C, #65483C, #AD644D, #C2A05B, #919B8B, #B28E65, #E8BA55). Strictly no text, labels, numbers or letters baked inside the artwork.

Arranged in an exact 4 rows by 5 columns matrix of 19 distinct drawn pictograms (slot 20 is completely empty with clean blank background):

Row 1 (Resources & Population):
1. wood: Small bundle of cut rustic oak firewood logs tied with twine rope (#65483C, #96704D).
2. stone: Three small rough-cut natural grey quarry stones/rocks piled together (#919B8B, #687574).
3. food: Woven wicker harvest basket overflowing with ripe golden wheat ears and purple turnips (#C2A05B, #87709B, #59845A).
4. coins: Stack of small ancient stamped bronze/gold round coins catching upper-right light (#E8BA55, #C2A05B).
5. population: Two small paired ancient villager bust silhouettes/figures standing together, wearing blue and linen tunics (#527B8C).

Row 2 (Metrics, Craft & Core Buildings):
6. happiness: Expressive cheerful smiling face icon in warm folk carved wood cameo style (#DEA078, #65483C).
7. construction: Heavy carpenter mallet hammer crossed with a notched timber joint mortise beam (#65483C, #919B8B).
8. technology: Rolled ancient parchment scroll folio paired with an antique notched brass gear cogwheel (#C2A05B, #E8BA55).
9. town_center: Miniature isometric pictogram of the specific two-story ancient town hall with dormer and blue banner (#527B8C banner, #919B8B stone base, thatch roof).
10. primitive_house: Miniature isometric pictogram of the specific 1x1 worker thatched clay cottage with open doorway (#AD644D plaster, thatch roof).

Row 3 (Production & Civic Buildings):
11. farm: Miniature isometric pictogram of the 2x2 agricultural plot with brown furrows, crop rows and rustic wattle fence (#B28E65 soil, green turnip tops, golden wheat).
12. lumber_camp: Miniature isometric pictogram of the woodcutter lean-to timber canopy with stacked oak logs and tree stump (#65483C).
13. stone_quarry: Miniature isometric pictogram of the exposed stepped grey limestone rock cliff face with pickaxe rest (#919B8B).
14. storage_hut: Miniature isometric pictogram of the raised clay storehouse building with stacked pottery urn and wooden crate (#AD644D).
15. research_hut: Miniature isometric pictogram of the scholar study hut with stepped thatch eaves and outdoor drafting scroll desk (#C2A05B thatch).

Row 4 (Infrastructure & Technical Trades):
16. dirt_road: Miniature isometric pictogram of a 4-way packed loam dirt path crossroad with fine stone pebbles and grass borders (#B28E65 path, #93AF75 grass).
17. agriculture: Sprouting green seedling shoot rising from freshly turned dark loam earth mound beside a single tall wheat ear (distinct from food basket and farm plot).
18. masonry: Squared hewn chisel-dressed stone ashlar blocks stacked with a steel mason chisel and mallet (distinct from raw stone pile and quarry).
19. toolmaking: Forged iron blacksmith anvil resting on a solid wood stump with a smith hand-hammer beside it.
20. [BLANK]: Generous empty clean flat parchment space (#E7DABC).

Every single icon has a completely unique silhouette. No emoji, no modern symbols. Authentic 16-bit pixel art craft on flat #E7DABC.
